title: Second-Order Spring-Mass-Damper Oscillator
description: Closed-loop second-order mechanical spring-mass-damper system with dual velocity and displacement integrators, spring stiffness and viscous damping feedback gains, and all component ports wired.
code:
MODEL: SpringMassDamper
TITLE: "Second-Order Mechanical Spring-Mass-Damper System"

COMPONENTS:
  UG01 TYPE=GP/UG TITLE="Step Force Source" X=100 Y=200
    PORTS: OUT=output
    XP: F_STEP=10.0
    FORTRAN:
      OUT = 10.0
    ENDFORTRAN

  SJ01 TYPE=GP/SJ TITLE="Force Summing Junction" X=250 Y=200
    XP: SGN1=1.0, SGN2=-1.0, SGN3=-1.0, K1=1.0, K2=1.0, K3=1.0

  GA01 TYPE=GP/GA TITLE="Inverse Mass 1/m" X=400 Y=200
    XP: K=0.5

  IN01 TYPE=GP/IN TITLE="Velocity Integrator" X=550 Y=200
    XP: GAIN=1.0, UL=100.0, LL=-100.0
    S0: S1=0.0

  IN02 TYPE=GP/IN TITLE="Displacement Integrator" X=700 Y=200
    XP: GAIN=1.0, UL=100.0, LL=-100.0
    S0: S1=0.0

  GA02 TYPE=GP/GA TITLE="Viscous Damping c" X=550 Y=350
    XP: K=1.2

  GA03 TYPE=GP/GA TITLE="Spring Stiffness k" X=700 Y=450
    XP: K=16.0

CONNECTIONS:
  UG01.OUT -> SJ01.IN1
  SJ01.OUT -> GA01.IN
  GA01.OUT -> IN01.IN
  IN01.OUT -> IN02.IN
  IN01.OUT -> GA02.IN
  GA02.OUT -> SJ01.IN2
  IN02.OUT -> GA03.IN
  GA03.OUT -> SJ01.IN3

title: Hydraulic Actuator Servo Valve Position Loop
description: Closed-loop aerospace hydraulic servo actuator featuring a position error summing junction, lead-lag phase compensator, servo valve flow limiter, and piston displacement integrator.
code:
MODEL: HydraulicServoActuator
TITLE: "Hydraulic Actuator Servo Valve Position Control Loop"

COMPONENTS:
  UG01 TYPE=GP/UG TITLE="Position Command" X=100 Y=200
    PORTS: OUT=output
    XP: POS_CMD=0.05
    FORTRAN:
      OUT = 0.05
    ENDFORTRAN

  SJ01 TYPE=GP/SJ TITLE="Position Error Sum" X=250 Y=200
    XP: SGN1=1.0, SGN2=-1.0, K1=1.0, K2=1.0

  LA01 TYPE=GP/LA TITLE="Servo Lead-Lag Compensator" X=420 Y=200
    XP: TAU1=0.04, TAU2=0.015, GAIN=3.2
    S0: S1=0.0

  LM01 TYPE=GP/LM TITLE="Spool Valve Flow Limiter" X=590 Y=200
    XP: UL=0.8, LL=-0.8

  IN01 TYPE=GP/IN TITLE="Hydraulic Piston Integrator" X=760 Y=200
    XP: GAIN=8.5, UL=0.15, LL=-0.15
    S0: S1=0.0

CONNECTIONS:
  UG01.OUT -> SJ01.IN1
  SJ01.OUT -> LA01.IN
  LA01.OUT -> LM01.IN
  LM01.OUT -> IN01.IN
  IN01.OUT -> SJ01.IN2

title: Electro-Hydrostatic Flight Control Actuator (EHA)
description: More-electric aircraft Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator (EHA) modeling a brushless motor-pump dynamic transfer function, pressure relief saturation, hydraulic cylinder integration, and LVDT position feedback.
code:
MODEL: ElectroHydrostaticActuator
TITLE: "Primary Flight Control Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator (EHA)"

COMPONENTS:
  UG01 TYPE=GP/UG TITLE="Aileron Deflection Command" X=80 Y=200
    PORTS: OUT=output
    XP: CMD_RAD=0.12
    FORTRAN:
      OUT = 0.12
    ENDFORTRAN

  SJ01 TYPE=GP/SJ TITLE="Position Error Junction" X=230 Y=200
    XP: SGN1=1.0, SGN2=-1.0, K1=1.0, K2=1.0

  GA01 TYPE=GP/GA TITLE="Proportional Controller" X=380 Y=200
    XP: K=18.0

  LM01 TYPE=GP/LM TITLE="Motor Speed Saturation" X=520 Y=200
    XP: UL=12.0, LL=-12.0

  TF01 TYPE=GP/TF TITLE="Motor-Pump Dynamics" X=680 Y=200
    XP: NUM=[1.0], DEN=[0.004, 0.12, 1.0]
    S0: S1=0.0, S2=0.0

  IN01 TYPE=GP/IN TITLE="Actuator Cylinder Displacement" X=850 Y=200
    XP: GAIN=2.4, UL=0.25, LL=-0.25
    S0: S1=0.0

  TF02 TYPE=GP/TF TITLE="LVDT Sensor Filter" X=520 Y=360
    XP: NUM=[1.0], DEN=[0.005, 1.0]
    S0: S1=0.0

CONNECTIONS:
  UG01.OUT -> SJ01.IN1
  SJ01.OUT -> GA01.IN
  GA01.OUT -> LM01.IN
  LM01.OUT -> TF01.IN
  TF01.OUT -> IN01.IN
  IN01.OUT -> TF02.IN
  TF02.OUT -> SJ01.IN2

title: Aircraft Environmental Control System Bleed Air Loop
description: Transport aircraft cabin temperature and pressure Environmental Control System (ECS) with dual-loop PI trim valve regulation, air-cycle pack thermal lag, duct transport delay, and cabin thermal capacitance.
code:
MODEL: AircraftEcsBleedAir
TITLE: "Aircraft Cabin ECS Bleed-Air Temperature Control Loop"

COMPONENTS:
  UG01 TYPE=GP/UG TITLE="Cabin Temp Setpoint (C)" X=80 Y=200
    PORTS: OUT=output
    XP: T_SET=22.0
    FORTRAN:
      OUT = 22.0
    ENDFORTRAN

  SJ01 TYPE=GP/SJ TITLE="Temperature Error" X=230 Y=200
    XP: SGN1=1.0, SGN2=-1.0, K1=1.0, K2=1.0

  LA01 TYPE=GP/LA TITLE="Trim Valve PI Compensator" X=380 Y=200
    XP: TAU1=2.5, TAU2=0.4, GAIN=0.8
    S0: S1=0.0

  LM01 TYPE=GP/LM TITLE="Trim Air Valve Stroke" X=540 Y=200
    XP: UL=1.0, LL=0.0

  TF01 TYPE=GP/TF TITLE="Air-Cycle Pack Heat Exchanger" X=700 Y=200
    XP: NUM=[35.0], DEN=[8.0, 1.0]
    S0: S1=20.0

  TD01 TYPE=GP/TD TITLE="Distribution Duct Transport Lag" X=860 Y=200
    XP: DELAY=1.5

  TF02 TYPE=GP/TF TITLE="Cabin Thermal Volume" X=1020 Y=200
    XP: NUM=[1.0], DEN=[45.0, 1.0]
    S0: S1=20.0

CONNECTIONS:
  UG01.OUT -> SJ01.IN1
  SJ01.OUT -> LA01.IN
  LA01.OUT -> LM01.IN
  LM01.OUT -> TF01.IN
  TF01.OUT -> TD01.IN
  TD01.OUT -> TF02.IN
  TF02.OUT -> SJ01.IN2

title: Gas Turbine Fuel Control Unit with Schedule Table
description: Aero-engine gas turbine FADEC Fuel Control Unit (FCU) coupling N2 spool speed regulation, acceleration fuel-limit clamping, combustor thermal lag, rotor inertia integration, and a companion acceleration schedule table.
code:
MODEL: GasTurbineFcu
TITLE: "Gas Turbine FADEC N2 Spool Speed Fuel Control Unit"

COMPONENTS:
  UG01 TYPE=GP/UG TITLE="Throttle N2 Reference (%)" X=80 Y=200
    PORTS: OUT=output
    XP: N2_REF=92.0
    FORTRAN:
      OUT = 92.0
    ENDFORTRAN

  SJ01 TYPE=GP/SJ TITLE="N2 Speed Error" X=230 Y=200
    XP: SGN1=1.0, SGN2=-1.0, K1=1.0, K2=1.0

  LA01 TYPE=GP/LA TITLE="FADEC Lead-Lag Governor" X=390 Y=200
    XP: TAU1=0.65, TAU2=0.12, GAIN=0.045
    S0: S1=0.0

  LM01 TYPE=GP/LM TITLE="Accel/Decel Fuel Flow Limiter" X=550 Y=200
    XP: UL=1.45, LL=0.12

  TF01 TYPE=GP/TF TITLE="Fuel Metering Valve & Combustor" X=720 Y=200
    XP: NUM=[1.0], DEN=[0.08, 1.0]
    S0: S1=0.25

  TF02 TYPE=GP/TF TITLE="High-Pressure Spool Rotor Dynamics" X=900 Y=200
    XP: NUM=[85.0], DEN=[1.8, 1.0]
    S0: S1=62.0

  TF03 TYPE=GP/TF TITLE="Tachometer Speed Sensor" X=550 Y=360
    XP: NUM=[1.0], DEN=[0.02, 1.0]
    S0: S1=62.0

CONNECTIONS:
  UG01.OUT -> SJ01.IN1
  SJ01.OUT -> LA01.IN
  LA01.OUT -> LM01.IN
  LM01.OUT -> TF01.IN
  TF01.OUT -> TF02.IN
  TF02.OUT -> TF03.IN
  TF03.OUT -> SJ01.IN2
